verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 7 258V is a laptop processor, so user-defined event-to-action automation rules are a software capability outside this product's category. Nothing in the evidence shows the chip ships such a feature: Copilot+ voice commands belong to the host platform, and vPro manageability is an adjacent IT-management feature, not a rules engine.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
